grades: Junior or senior in high school when you apply
name: Pre-College Cancer Engineering Summer Institute (PRE-CE)
org: Cancer Center at Illinois, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: Join a faculty research team at the Cancer Center at Illinois for the summer. You are paired with another high school student in the same lab. You also do career workshops and get mentoring.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors. The page says PRE-CE adds research spots for students with strong interest and promise. That includes students from rural or under-served communities. It runs next to researcHStart (a separate card).
duration: About 8 weeks, 40 hours a week, from the second full week of June to the first week of August
deadline_text: Dates and the deadline are announced with application materials each fall. 2027 dates are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Application materials come out each fall. For PRE-CE, contact Stephanie Dietrich. She is the Senior Manager for Education. Her email is sdrich@illinois.edu.
notes: PRE-CE runs at the same time as researcHStart. The Cancer Center at Illinois is a host site for it. For researcHStart you must be 16 or older. You apply online with two recommendations and then have an in-person interview. The stipend is taxable. Dates for 2027 are not posted. Past summers ran from the second full week of June to the first week of August.
